_comment: Curated research links shown in-app under '📚 Forskning'. PURPOSE: let users dig deeper AND clearly see WHO funded/mandated each study, so producer research is visibly separated from independent/official research. The app reads this file (https://matsjekk.com/data/research_links.json) once per day; new entries reach users WITHOUT a new app release.
_principle: We never hide producer studies and never present them as independent. Each entry is labeled with its funding and the mandate it was set up to answer. Stating who funded a study is a verifiable FACT, not a claim that the study is wrong — it is consumer context.

_schema.title: localized short title { nb, en } (other locales fall back to en)
_schema.publisher: who performed/published it (e.g. EFSA, VKM, university, producer)
_schema.funding: independent | public | academic | ngo | industry | unknown
_schema.mandate: localized one-line description of what the research was set up to answer { nb, en }
_schema._note: BUCKETS in UI: independent/public/academic/ngo => '🟢 Uavhengig & offentlig'; industry => '🟡 Produsent-/bransjefinansiert'. Human verifies every link before adding.

title.nb: EU/EFSA – sikkerhets- og effektvurdering av Bovaer (3-NOP)
title.en: EU/EFSA – safety and efficacy assessment of Bovaer (3-NOP)

mandate.nb: Uavhengig myndighetsvurdering av om fôrtilsetningen er trygg for dyr, forbruker og miljø før godkjenning i EU.
mandate.en: Independent regulatory assessment of whether the feed additive is safe for animals, consumers and the environment before EU authorisation.

mandate.nb: Produsentens egen dokumentasjon av virkning (metanreduksjon) – laget for å markedsføre og få godkjent produktet.
mandate.en: The producer's own documentation of effect (methane reduction) – produced to market and obtain approval for the product.

title.en: European Commission – New Genomic Techniques (NGT) in plants

mandate.nb: Offisiell oversikt over EUs pågående regelverksarbeid for NGT/GMO – grunnlaget for hva som må merkes.
mandate.en: Official overview of the EU's ongoing NGT/GMO regulatory work – the basis for what must be labelled.

title.nb: VKM – norsk uavhengig risikovurdering (mat og miljø)
title.en: VKM – Norwegian independent risk assessment (food and environment)

mandate.nb: Uavhengig faglig risikovurdering på oppdrag for norske myndigheter – ikke bundet av produsentinteresser.
mandate.en: Independent scientific risk assessment commissioned by Norwegian authorities – not bound by producer interests.

title.nb: EU – godkjenning av insekter som ny mat (Novel Food)
title.en: EU – authorisation of insects as Novel Food

mandate.nb: Offisiell liste over hvilke insektarter som er vurdert og godkjent som mat/fôr i EU, med sikkerhetsvurdering.
mandate.en: Official list of which insect species have been assessed and authorised as food/feed in the EU, with safety assessment.
